projects.title: Well pump & motor replacement
projects.summary: Crew pulled a submersible pump set at 320 ft in a 354-ft well and found the pump end clogged with sediment and the drop wire failed. Installed a new submersible pump end, 2 HP motor, new drop wire, stainless couplings, check valve and well seal. System tested and returned to full service.
